name: Brimstone Heart, Greater
body:
School transmutation [evil]; Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 8, sorcerer/wizard 8

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like lesser brimstone heart, except you gain low-light vision; darkvision 60 feet; DR 15/good; immunity to cold, fire, and poison; resistance to acid and electricity 10; a +4 racial bonus on saves against compulsion; a spell resistance of 11 plus your caster level, and see in darkness and telepathy out to 100 feet as supernatural abilities for the duration of the spell. Also, your wings give you a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability.
